title: Build the Gram matrix and score the dual
brief: Compute a table of pairwise similarities, then score points and the dual objective from the pushes alone.
hints: The linear Gram matrix is X @ X.T. The RBF kernel needs squared distances: ||a - b||^2 = ||a||^2 + ||b||^2 - 2 a.b, so build it from the linear Gram matrix and its diagonal.
Squared distances computed this way can come out as -1e-16 on the diagonal. Clip them at 0 before you call exp, or take them from broadcasting differences instead.
dual_scores is f = (alpha * y) @ K + b. The vector alpha * y holds each house's signed push.
dual_objective is alpha.sum() - 0.5 * v @ K @ v with v = alpha * y. Dropping the labels in v is the usual mistake.
